reference: By the time she looked up, the spiral had vanished completely.
sk: Kým zdvihla oči, špirála zmizla úplne.
cz: Než zvedla oči, spirála zmizela úplně.
acceptable: By the time she {looked up|raised her eyes|lifted her eyes}, the spiral had {vanished|disappeared|gone} {completely|entirely}.
By the time she {looked up|raised her eyes|lifted her eyes}, the spiral had {completely|entirely} {vanished|disappeared|gone}.
The spiral had {completely |entirely |}{vanished|disappeared|gone} by the time she {looked up|raised her eyes|lifted her eyes}.
The spiral had {vanished|disappeared|gone} {completely|entirely} by the time she {looked up|raised her eyes|lifted her eyes}.

mistakes.text: By the time she looked up, the spiral {vanished|disappeared} completely.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri „by the time“ bol dej hlavnej vety hotový skôr, preto Past Perfect: „had vanished“, nie „vanished“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U „by the time“ byl děj hlavní věty hotový dřív, proto Past Perfect: „had vanished“, ne „vanished“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With “by the time”, the main action was finished earlier, so use Past Perfect: “had vanished”, not “vanished”.

mistakes.text: By the time she had looked up, the spiral {vanished|disappeared} completely.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Perfect patrí k skoršiemu deju v hlavnej vete: „had vanished“; po „by the time“ zostáva Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Perfect patří k dřívějšímu ději v hlavní větě: „had vanished“; po „by the time“ zůstává Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Perfect goes with the earlier action in the main clause: “had vanished”; after “by the time” keep Past Simple.

mistakes.text: Until she looked up, the spiral had {vanished|disappeared} completely.
mistakes.kind: until instead of by the time
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Kým“ tu znamená „by the time“ (do tej chvíle), nie „until“ (až kým).
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Než“ tu znamená „by the time“ (do té chvíle), ne „until“ (dokud).
mistakes.feedback_en: Here the meaning is “by the time” (at or before that moment), not “until”.

mistakes.text: By the time she looked up, the spiral has {vanished|disappeared} completely.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Príbeh je v minulosti, preto Past Perfect „had vanished“, nie Present Perfect „has vanished“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Příběh je v minulosti, proto Past Perfect „had vanished“, ne Present Perfect „has vanished“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The story is in the past, so use Past Perfect “had vanished”, not Present Perfect “has vanished”.
